summary: Surface access.zfs_pool on registered ZFS repository rows, make resilver progress print the quantity its percentage came from, and raise pool-summary attention for leaf error counts or a non-empty ZFS status sentence (SR-041–044 / BUG-0488–0490). API impact: none.

guide.reason: Registered OpenZFS datasets now show the pool detail line under Host access; docs/guide/storage-repositories.md notes that path beside the provisioned host-row behaviour.

api.reason: No Controller/Core wire change and no docs/API.md edit. StorageAccess.zfs_pool and leaf error fields were already on the contract; this change only types and renders them in the Storage UI.

roadmap.reason: UI bug fixes for already-shipped ZFS observation display; no roadmap milestone moved.

state.reason: Presentation-only. Durable pool/repository state remains on the pool master; the Controller still stores none of the zpool observation.

verification.method: node web/src/storage.test.mjs; npm --prefix web run typecheck; python3 scripts/check_docs.py --worktree (scoped to this change's paths).
